name: Microsoft IPC
purpose: Existing C++/.NET applications need the same shared-memory protocol and low-copy behavior. | Restore current MSVC/.NET builds; run cross-process tests for crashes, shutdown, message ownership and permissions; audit Boost and optional Bond. | Named pipes or an existing supported messaging library; benchmark using the actual payloads.

name: Tx
purpose: LINQ-style ETW queries provide reusable analysis that would otherwise be rewritten. | Port only needed readers/operators to the chosen .NET and Rx versions; replay known trace fixtures. | TraceEvent/PerfView APIs or KrabsETW plus a small query layer.

name: SharpDX
purpose: A working legacy application needs narrow fixes and migration would be disproportionately large. | Isolate required assemblies; verify COM lifetime, ABI, architecture and current Windows behavior. | Vortice.Windows and current generated bindings; avoid restoring unused API families.

name: CrashRpt3
purpose: An application needs their Windows exception-handler behavior or existing report format. | Compare patch lineage; build a crash-type test matrix including fail-fast, stack overflow, thread handling and dump integrity. | Crashpad integration or application-specific WER/minidump handling.

name: CrashRpt2
purpose: An application needs their Windows exception-handler behavior or existing report format. | Compare patch lineage; build a crash-type test matrix including fail-fast, stack overflow, thread handling and dump integrity. | Crashpad integration or application-specific WER/minidump handling.

name: Microsoft PDB
purpose: A missing debug-record definition or parser behavior blocks a symbol tool. | Extract the minimum needed record definitions and tests; README explicitly says the full source does not currently build. | RawPDB, DIA SDK or LLVM PDB tooling.

name: C++ REST SDK
purpose: Existing code depends heavily on its asynchronous API and migration cost is substantial. | Scope transport/TLS dependencies and regression tests; restore only the application-required functionality. | libcurl or Boost.Beast, as suggested by the archived upstream.

name: Bond
purpose: Existing stored data or deployed peers require Bond wire compatibility. | Test binary-format fixtures and schema evolution; audit parser/compiler dependencies and own necessary security fixes. | A maintained serialization format for new protocols, with a migration bridge for existing data.
